weeks.title: Remote Onboarding, Workspace Setup & Version Control
weeks.summary: Establish professional development toolchains, Git best practices, and familiarize with Uzair AI Studio coding standards.
objectives: Configure modern developer toolchain (VS Code, Git, Node.js / Python environment).
Master GitHub branching strategies (feature branches, conventional commits, pull requests).
Understand remote communication protocols and weekly sprint deliverables.

tasks.title: Local Developer Workspace & Repository Setup
tasks.description: Install required compilers/runtimes, configure Git global user identity, clone the starter project, and verify local build execution.
tasks.hint: Submit your public GitHub profile and repository URL.

tasks.title: Clean Git Branching & First Code Contribution
tasks.description: Create a feature branch `feat/onboarding-setup`, write a modular utility function with unit tests, open a pull request, and merge cleanly.
tasks.hint: Provide the commit hash or merged pull request link.

weeks.title: Core Domain Architecture & Component Engineering
weeks.summary: Build high-performance, modular system foundations according to domain best practices.
objectives: Architect clean separation of concerns (presentation, business logic, data access).
Implement responsive, accessible UI modules or modular backend service layers.
Ensure type safety and adherence to design systems.

tasks.title: Modular Architecture Implementation
tasks.description: Design and scaffold the foundational architecture for your track (e.g. component hierarchy in Web Dev, data preprocessing pipelines in AI/Data Science).
tasks.hint: Include a brief README describing the module hierarchy.

tasks.title: Interactive Responsive Component / Algorithm Pipeline
tasks.description: Implement at least 3 interactive components or data processing algorithms with responsive layout and graceful error handling.
tasks.deliverableType: Live Demo Link or Code Gist
tasks.hint: Host on a live preview (e.g. Vercel / GitHub Pages / Streamlit).

weeks.title: RESTful APIs, State Management & Cloud Integration
weeks.summary: Connect frontend interfaces to scalable backend services, asynchronous endpoints, and external APIs.
objectives: Implement robust asynchronous data fetching with optimistic updates.
Manage global application state with centralized stores and caching.
Handle offline state, network timeouts, and HTTP status codes.

tasks.title: Async API Client & Error Boundary
tasks.description: Construct an API communication client with retry logic, request headers, error boundaries, and token authorization.
tasks.hint: Provide code link demonstrating handling of 4xx/5xx responses.

tasks.title: Global State & Reactive Data Flow
tasks.description: Implement centralized state management ensuring reactive updates across multi-view interfaces without unnecessary re-renders.
tasks.hint: Describe the state management pattern used in your submission notes.

weeks.title: Mid-Term Production Milestone & Architectural Review
weeks.summary: Milestone Review 1: Deploy a functional end-to-end prototype for evaluation by Mentor Muhammad Uzair.
objectives: Assemble completed modules into a unified working system.
Deploy to a public staging environment.
Participate in mid-term code review and incorporate architectural feedback.

tasks.title: End-to-End Staging Deployment (Milestone 1)
tasks.description: Deploy the complete 4-week prototype to a live hosting environment (e.g. Vercel, Netlify, Render, Railway).
tasks.hint: Ensure the live link is accessible publicly without login barriers.

tasks.title: Mid-Term Sprint Retrospective & Code Documentation
tasks.description: Write a 1-page architecture review documenting technical trade-offs, performance bottlenecks resolved, and upcoming sprint goals.
tasks.hint: Submit via Google Drive or directly inside repository docs.

weeks.title: Advanced Engineering: AI Integration, Scaling & Performance
weeks.summary: Enhance system capabilities with machine learning models, database optimization, or advanced algorithms.
objectives: Integrate external AI APIs (OpenAI, Gemini, Anthropic) or local ML models.
Profile computational hotspots and optimize data structures.
Implement lazy loading, code splitting, and caching strategies.

tasks.title: AI Model / Intelligent Service Integration
tasks.description: Incorporate an intelligent feature (e.g. natural language processing, automated analytics, recommendation system, or predictive model).
tasks.hint: Provide prompts/weights configuration and integration snippet.

tasks.title: High-Throughput Performance Optimization
tasks.description: Conduct performance audits, optimize asset delivery, minimize query latency, and achieve a 90+ Lighthouse / benchmark score.

weeks.title: Quality Assurance, Security Hardening & Automated Testing
weeks.summary: Ensure production resilience through comprehensive automated test suites and defensive security practices.
objectives: Author unit, integration, and end-to-end tests.
Sanitize inputs to protect against XSS, SQL/NoSQL injection, and CSRF.
Implement secure secrets management and environment variable segregation.

tasks.title: Automated Test Suite Implementation
tasks.description: Write a comprehensive test suite (Jest, PyTest, or Playwright) covering critical user flows and edge cases with at least 80% coverage.
tasks.hint: Include command to run tests locally in submission notes.

tasks.title: Security Audit & Vulnerability Remediation
tasks.description: Review application security: sanitize client inputs, implement strict CORS policies, rate limiting, and dependency vulnerability scanning.
tasks.hint: List resolved vulnerabilities and security headers configured.

weeks.title: Cloud Deployment, CI/CD Pipelines & DevOps Staging
weeks.summary: Automate build, test, and deployment workflows with modern continuous integration pipelines.
objectives: Configure GitHub Actions or equivalent CI/CD pipelines.
Set up multi-environment deployments (staging, production).
Implement telemetry, health checks, and error monitoring.

tasks.title: CI/CD Pipeline Configuration
tasks.description: Create a GitHub Actions workflow that automatically runs linting, executes test suites, and triggers production deployment on git push.

tasks.title: Production Monitoring & Health Telemetry
tasks.description: Implement uptime health check endpoints (`/api/health`), structured logging, and error tracking integrations.
tasks.hint: Provide a link to your live `/api/health` status.

weeks.title: Capstone Delivery, Technical Documentation & Graduation
weeks.summary: Final Capstone Presentation: Deliver your polished project, present technical findings, and receive graduation credentials.
objectives: Deliver finalized production system with documentation.
Present capstone project demonstration to studio leadership.
Unlock official Certificate of Completion, LOR, and Experience Letter.

tasks.title: Final Capstone Production Release
tasks.description: Deploy the final capstone build with custom domain / stable production URL, comprehensive documentation, and architectural schema.
tasks.hint: Submit final GitHub repository with comprehensive README.

tasks.title: Graduation Defense & Internship Portfolio Report
tasks.description: Compile a portfolio case study showcasing your 8-week journey, key technical achievements, and submit your graduation clearance request.
tasks.hint: Upon mentor review, all official graduation documents unlock instantly.
